ohtani.title: Three-run homers from Taylor, Semien fuel Mets' win
ohtani.blurb: Tyrone Taylor and Marcus Semien hit three-run home runs in back-to-back innings, leading the Mets to an 8-3 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong's big day powers Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong tallies three RBIs and Shota Imanaga tosses six scoreless innings in the Cubs' shutout win against the Pirates

suzuki.title: Ryan O'Hearn's grand slam powers Pirates' 8-7 victory
suzuki.blurb: Ryan O'Hearn crushes a grand slam, plus Esmerlyn Valdez and Shawn Ross hit homers in the Pirates' 8-7 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Jarren Duran, Wilyer Abreu lead Red Sox to 6-1 win
yoshida.blurb: Jarren Duran tallies three hits and two RBIs, plus Wilyer Abreu hits an RBI double to lead the Red Sox to a 6-1 win over the Blue Jays

okamoto.title: Jarren Duran, Wilyer Abreu lead Red Sox to 6-1 win
okamoto.blurb: Jarren Duran tallies three hits and two RBIs, plus Wilyer Abreu hits an RBI double to lead the Red Sox to a 6-1 win over the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Munetaka Murakami's six RBIs powers White Sox in win
murakami.blurb: Munetaka Murakami hits two home runs and collects six RBIs on his bobblehead day to lead the White Sox to 12-3 win over the Astros

matsui.title: Machado and Merrill homer in Padres' comeback win
matsui.blurb: Padres rally late, led by game-tying and go-ahead homers by Manny Machado and Jackson Merrill, to beat the Marlins 5-3 and complete the sweep
